name: CLIProxyAPI
description: OpenAI-compatible API proxy for CLI model providers, with persistent authentication and generated API access credentials.

configFields.label: API key
configFields.help: Auto-generated. Use this key to authenticate requests to the proxy API.

files.content:
host: 0.0.0.0
port: 8317
auth-dir: /root/.cli-proxy-api
api-keys:
  - "{{config:API_KEY}}"
debug: false
logging-to-file: true
usage-statistics-enabled: true

connection.title: Connect to CLIProxyAPI
connection.description: Use the OpenAI-compatible base URL and generated API key in your clients. Add and manage provider accounts from the CLIProxyAPI user interface.

intro.en: Your project gets an OpenAI-compatible endpoint backed by CLIProxyAPI. Provider accounts and installed plugins persist across container restarts.
intro.zh: 你的项目将获得一个由 CLIProxyAPI 提供的 OpenAI 兼容接口；服务商账号和已安装插件会在容器重启后保留。

useHint.en: Add provider accounts from the CLIProxyAPI user interface, then read OPENAI_BASE_URL and OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment after redeploying your project.
useHint.zh: 在 CLIProxyAPI 用户页面添加服务商账号，然后重新部署项目并读取 OPENAI_BASE_URL 和 OPENAI_API_KEY。
